cases.name: Sarah Emily Roque
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "SGT Roque enlisted into the U.S. Army on 30 June 2020 to become a Combat Engineer, beginning her career with One Station Unit Training at Fort Leonard Wood, Missouri, and entering her aspired profession. Her first unit of assignment was the 50TH Multirole Bridge Company, 5TH Engineer Battalion, 36TH Engineer Brigade, located at Fort Leonard Wood, Missouri. She served in the unit from 20 October 2020 to 21 August 2022 as a bridge crewmember and boat operator.  She volunteered for a tour of duty as a boat operator with 74TH Multirole Bridge Company in Poland. SGT Roque re-enlisted for the opportunity to become a Mine Detection Dog Handler and served as a Team Leader in the 94TH Engineer Detachment, Engineer Mine Dog Detachment from 22 August 2022 until her passing.

Her awards consist of the Meritorious Service Medal, Army Achievement Medal, Army Good Conduct Medal, National Defense Service Medal, and the Army Service Ribbon."
cases.narrative: In 10/21/2024, her body was found in a dumpster on base after unit members searched for her after she was missing from her morning formation at Fort Leonard Wood in MO.
